name: Preet Kotak
text:
As a radiologist, I find this overhyped. The superficial temporal artery is simply a peripheral artery carrying the same cardiac pulse already measured by wrist-based wearables. Detecting its pulsations isn’t some revolutionary discovery.

The real question isn’t whether you can detect a pulse at the temple, but whether you can demonstrate a meaningful advantage over existing sensors.

An internal study, selectively presented percentages and a 5-bpm accuracy threshold don’t establish scientific superiority. Where is the independent ECG validation?

A new anatomical location doesn’t automatically mean a new technological breakthrough. We need better evidence, not another wearable selling a solution to a problem that may not exist.

name: ネトラ
text:
@temple @deepigoyal I read your research, and it doesn't say what your posts say.

BrainFlow: Temple sits over the superficial temporal artery, a branch of the external carotid that feeds the scalp, not the brain. Your Doppler study used exercise and lying down, where scalp and brain blood move together. Its authors say the match "does not by itself establish a specifically cerebral contribution." Your NIRS study is stronger in one test, head-down tilt, but its "brain" signal is a model estimate. The scalp was measured on the opposite forehead, and the paper says brain-specific tracking is still "to be established." Your post said 60 participants, but it was 60 sessions from 44 men, no women. No study tests stress, mood or mental health.

Heart rate: five wearables, in your own unblinded study, on a treadmill, with 43 people aged 20 to 35. Temple beat the Apple Watch by 0.85 bpm. You graded it against an ECG chest strap, and your untaped strap, between dropouts, was more accurate than Temple (0.59 vs 1.18 bpm).

The heart-rate result is real, but small and from your own lab. "Brain flow" and "beats all flagships" are not proven.

On Shark Tank, you walked away from a pitch over typos: "Attention to detail, man." Your marketing deserves the same standard. Let it say what your scientists wrote. Please don't exaggerate and mislead people into spending their hard-earned money.

Sources: Gulati D, et al. | Kumar A, et al. | Liu D, et al. | Temple heart-rate white paper (temple.com/science-and-research)

Doctors argue it is scientifically misleading to claim that surface-level optical sensors on the temple can genuinely track complex internal metrics like "brain blood flow" or deep neurological states.

Lack of Independent, Peer-Reviewed Validation

Dear Mr. Deepinder Goyal,
I am writing to you with a humble request and the hope that you will personally look into my situation.

I sincerely hope my request will reach your heart.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
Regards,
Paltu Das

name: Rohit arora
text:
सभी भाइयों से निवेदन है कि सोच-समझकर ही ज़ोमैटो (Zomato) और स्विगी (Swiggy) जॉइन करें। इन कंपनियों को अपनी ताकत दिखाओ ताकि ये हमारा पे-आउट (कमाई) बढ़ाने पर मजबूर हो जाएं। इन कंपनियों के पास मार्केटिंग करने के लिए तो बहुत पैसा है, लेकिन जब राइडर्स (Riders) को पेमेंट देने की बात आती है, तो ये उनका खून-पसीना एक करने के बाद भी पूरा हक नहीं देतीं।
हमें बेस पे (Base Pay) बढ़वाने पर जोर देना होगा, नहीं तो ये कंपनियां और अमीर बनती जाएंगी और हमारा शोषण होता रहेगा। किसी भी राइडर (Rider) भाई को इनके 'रेफरल बोनस' (Referral) के लालच में नहीं आना चाहिए। रेफर करके आप खुद अपने काम को बांट रहे हैं, क्योंकि जितने ज्यादा लोग आएंगे, ऑर्डर्स (Orders) उतने ही कम मिलेंगे। इससे न तो आपके ऑर्डर्स (Orders) पूरे होंगे और न ही दूसरे किसी भाई का काम पूरा होगा।
एक बात अच्छी तरह समझ लो—अगर ऐप पर राइडर्स (Riders) की संख्या ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा बढ़ती जाएगी, तो ये कंपनियां पे-आउट और कम कर देंगी। फिर हमारी जायज मांगें कभी पूरी नहीं हो पाएंगी, क्योंकि इनके पास काम करने वाले राइडर्स (Riders) की कोई कमी नहीं होगी। जब तक इनके पास लोगों की कमी नहीं होगी, इनके पास हमारी बात मानने की कोई वजह भी नहीं होगी।
इसलिए कृपया करके 1,000, 1,500 या 2,000 रुपये के छोटे से रेफरल लालच में आकर दूसरों को जॉइन करवाना तुरंत बंद करें। इस लालच को छोड़ें और अपना काम पूरी मेहनत और ईमानदारी से करते जाएं ताकि आपको अपनी मेहनत का सही फल मिलता रहे। अपनी कमाई (पे-आउट) बढ़वाने के लिए एकजुट हों!

My Experience with Blinkit – A Serious Consumer Safety Concern

I purchased OnePlus Nord Buds 4 through Blinkit for ₹3,104. Unfortunately, the product has a visible manufacturing defect. A protruding damaged part physically pokes my ear and causes discomfort.

Despite sharing evidence and repeatedly contacting Blinkit’s support team, they have refused to resolve the issue and keep redirecting me to the brand.

I have the original tax invoice, photographs, videos and complete chat records as evidence.

A customer should not have to fight this hard just to get support for a defective and potentially unsafe product.

@letsblinkit – Is this your standard for customer grievance handling?

I am escalating this matter through the appropriate consumer authorities.

Consumers deserve accountability, not excuses.

#Blinkit #OnePlus #ConsumerRights #ConsumerSafety #ConsumerComplaint

name: HARESH BHARGA
text:
Dear @deepigoyal,
No matter how many complaints arise, how many operational challenges your teams face, or how many technical problems they solve behind the scenes, I believe there is tremendous hard work happening every day to keep improving the experience for everyone.
Beyond the business, technology, and numbers, I want to appreciate Zomato for creating flexible employment opportunities for delivery partners, pickers, and many others.
These opportunities are about more than earning money. They help people support their families, fulfil their small and big dreams, and move towards a better future.
Sometimes, the impact of a business isn't measured only by its growth or valuation, but by the number of lives it helps improve.
My appreciation to you and your entire team for building a platform that creates opportunities for so many people. Every opportunity can make a meaningful difference in someone's family and life.
Keep building, keep improving, and keep creating opportunities. 🙌

text:
@Zomato — Please look into this urgently.
I placed an order from Ashu Amritsari Kulcha Corner, Model Town, Jalandhar on 21 August 2026 at 9:16 AM for ₹426.48. The assigned delivery partner, Ghanshyam Shukla, called me twice regarding my location. I explained my location clearly, but he asked me to come to a place far from my actual location to collect the order.
I went there, but he was not available. I called him through the Zomato app, but he did not answer. Shortly afterwards, I received a notification saying that my order had been delivered—even though I never received it.
I immediately contacted Zomato support, but my issue was not resolved. I was repeatedly told that the delivery partner had switched off his phone and that Zomato could neither help nor provide a refund.
This is extremely concerning and feels like a serious delivery fraud/scam. I have screenshots and evidence of the entire incident.
I request Zomato to investigate this matter urgently, refund my ₹426.48, and take appropriate action against the delivery partner.
₹426.48 may be a small amount for a company like Zomato, but it is my hard-earned money. Please don't ignore this.

Subject: Complaint Regarding Harassment, Staff Behaviour and Excessive Order Delays at R City Mall, Ghatkopar West
Dear Zomato Support Team,
I am Akash Yadav, Zomato Delivery Partner, Delivery Partner ID: FE7775510.
I would like to raise a serious complaint regarding the restaurants located at R City Mall, Ghatkopar West.
The biggest concern is the behaviour of some restaurant staff towards delivery partners. They often do not communicate properly or respectfully with us, and at times their behaviour feels like unnecessary harassment. Delivery partners should be treated respectfully while collecting orders.
Another major issue is the excessive waiting time. Orders from these restaurants are frequently delayed, and sometimes we have to wait 30 minutes or even longer for a single order. This affects our delivery time, performance and earnings.
There is also an issue with communication. When delivery partners call the restaurants regarding an order, the calls are often not answered, and proper information or assistance is not provided.
I request Zomato to please investigate this matter seriously, especially regarding:
Unprofessional and disrespectful behaviour towards delivery partners.
Unnecessary harassment of delivery partners.
Excessive waiting time for orders.
Frequent delays in preparing and handing over orders.
Restaurants not answering delivery partners' calls.
Lack of proper communication and cooperation from restaurant staff.
I request Zomato to take appropriate action and ensure that delivery partners do not have to face unnecessary harassment, disrespect or unreasonable waiting times while doing their work.
Please acknowledge my complaint and inform me about the action taken regarding this issue.
Regards,
Akash Yadav
Zomato Delivery Partner
Partner ID: FE7775510

On Sunday, 06/09, we placed a food order through Zomato .Order ID 8569246374.However, the delivery partner did not deliver the order to our location. Within approximately 10 minutes, the Zomato app showed the order status as “Delivered.”
We tried contacting the delivery partner multiple times, but there was no response. We then contacted the restaurant, and they informed us that the delivery partner had already collected the order and advised us to contact Zomato customer support.
We were unable to find an official customer service number. Through the support chat, we were asked to send an email to customer service. We did so, but we only received automated responses.
Later, we tried calling a customer service number that we found on Google. Someone answered the call and instructed us to install an application to raise a customer complaint. Following their instructions, we installed the application. Subsequently, we noticed that ₹2,000 had been debited from our bank account without our knowledge or authorization.
We believe that we may have been a victim of a fraudulent scam while attempting to contact customer support. We request immediate assistance in investigating this unauthorized transaction and taking the necessary action.

text:
Respected Mr. Albinder Dhindsa,

Have you become so busy focusing on Blinkit’s revenue and company growth that you have forgotten about the employees who have been working day and night for several years to help your company reach this position?

Employees work hard throughout the year and look forward to celebrating festivals with their families. Is it fair to disappoint them in the name of a Diwali bonus, especially during such an important festival?

Sir, please also think about the happiness of the employees who contribute to your company’s growth. Diwali comes only once a year, so please consider giving employees a bonus of at least 50–60% of their monthly salary.

This amount may not be very significant for you, but for an ordinary employee and their family, even this small support can bring great happiness.

A company does not become great through profits alone; it becomes great through the hard work, dedication, and happiness of the employees who help it grow.

I sincerely hope you will understand the hard work and feelings of your employees and give serious consideration to this request.

Thank you.

सेवा में,
ज़ोमैटो कस्टमर सपोर्ट टीम
विषय: गलती से कैंसल हुए ऑर्डर का पूरा रिफंड देने हेतु अनुरोध
महोदय/महोदया,
मेरा मोबाइल नंबर 7023347659 है।
मैंने ज़ोमैटो पर Shahi Darbar से एक ऑर्डर किया था। मेरा फ़ोन हैंग हो जाने के कारण ऑर्डर गलती से कैंसल हो गया। मुझे न तो ऑर्डर प्राप्त हुआ और न ही मेरा पूरा रिफंड मिला।
सपोर्ट चैट में दिखाया गया है कि ₹237.56 का Cancellation Charge काट लिया गया है। चूँकि ऑर्डर मुझे मिला ही नहीं, इसलिए कृपया मेरे मामले की दोबारा जाँच करें और मेरे ऑर्डर की पूरी राशि का रिफंड जल्द से जल्द मेरे मूल भुगतान माध्यम में जारी करें।
यदि मेरा रिफंड शीघ्र जारी नहीं किया गया, तो मुझे मजबूर होकर संबंधित उपभोक्ता शिकायत मंच और अन्य उचित माध्यमों पर इसकी शिकायत दर्ज करानी पड़ेगी।
आशा है कि आप मेरे अनुरोध पर जल्द कार्रवाई करेंगे और मुझे मेरे रिफंड की जानकारी देंगे।
मोबाइल नंबर: 7023347659
धन्यवाद।
भवदीय,
रिहान

name: S_I_L_O_N(Life Style | Food | Fashion)
text:
Dear Zomato Escalation Team,

I am extremely disappointed with how my complaint has been handled. I reported receiving food that had a foul smell, appeared stale, and was completely inedible. Instead of investigating the issue properly, my complaint was closed with a generic response and without any resolution.

As a customer, this feels deeply unfair. When customers report genuine food quality and safety concerns but are denied refunds without a transparent investigation, it creates the impression that customer complaints are not being taken seriously.

I have paid for a meal that I could not consume, yet my refund has been denied. This experience has severely affected my trust in Zomato's customer support.

I request an immediate full refund. If this matter is not resolved promptly, I will share my personal experience publicly on social media and consumer platforms and pursue the matter through the appropriate consumer grievance channels.

I hope Zomato will review this case fairly and resolve it without further escalation.

name: Dr. Shristy Mishra
text:
Orderid-8364107359

I received a frappé that tasted sour, and the milk appeared to be spoiled. It was completely undrinkable, and I had to discard it. Serving a dairy product in this condition is a serious food quality concern and has the potential to put customers' health at risk.

I paid in advance through Zomato, yet I was left with an unsafe product and the burden of chasing a resolution. Whether the responsibility lies with the restaurant for preparing and serving it or with Zomato for failing to protect its customers, this experience is unacceptable.

Customers pay for safe, fresh food—not products that raise concerns about food safety. Both the restaurant and Zomato need to take accountability instead of leaving paying customers to deal with the consequences. I expect a full refund and a proper investigation into how such a product was allowed to reach a customer.

name: Jk
text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Zomato.

I ordered a biryani from Pista House worth ₹500, but the food smelled extremely bad and was not fit to eat. I immediately contacted Zomato customer support, expecting them to help with a refund or resolution. Instead, I was simply told that they could only share my feedback with the restaurant. That was the end of it.

As a customer, paying for food that arrives in such poor condition and receiving no meaningful support is unacceptable. There was no accountability and no genuine effort to resolve the issue.

Based on my experience, I would strongly advise people to think twice before ordering through Zomato. I personally had a much better experience with Swiggy’s customer support, as they seem to value and assist their customers when problems arise.

I hope Zomato improves its customer service and takes food quality complaints more seriously.
